quotes.verbatim_quote:
Remember! This example and all other examples for the project
lessons are models of the type of sold line to be improvised. The
important consideration is the spontaneous invention of your own
solo line. The point of the project lessons is to hone your tech-
nique to a level that will facilitate and not hinder the immediate
reproduction of any and all of your musical ideas. Use the exam-
ples as source material and for reference, but when doing the
project lessons, it's "every man for himself".
quotes.why_load_bearing: Articulates the core didactic principle that technique training serves spontaneous musical expression, defining the purpose of practice as enabling — not constraining — improvisation.
